description: Claim/evidence obligation classes for the Research OS obligation graph. Each material claim carries obligations from these classes. Obligation statuses are shared across classes. A WAIVED_WITH_REASON obligation can NEVER raise a claim ceiling.

classes.description: The primary source documenting the claim must be located and identified.
Full text, methods or supplementary material must be accessible to verify constructs and procedures.
Underlying data tables or repositories must be accessible for recomputation.
Numeric claims must be independently recomputed where feasible.
Constructs, outcomes and denominators must be explicitly defined and crosswalked.
Source-chain independence must be verified; single-chain dependence is flagged.
Replication, null and contradictory evidence must be sought.
Causal identification strategy must be specified where a causal claim is made.
Population, jurisdiction and temporal scope must be verified against the claim.
Alternative mechanisms must be considered where a mechanism claim is made.
Adverse effects, costs or harmed-subject evidence must be present when applicable.
External human or domain review is required before high-stakes or publication claims.
